description: This file contains the implementation of block management functions within the 'app' package, including CRUD operations, notifications, and hierarchy traversal for blocks in a project management or note-taking application.

methods.name: GetBlocks
methods.description: Retrieves blocks based on board ID, parent ID, and block type with filtering logic.

methods.name: DuplicateBlock
methods.description: Duplicates a block within a board, optionally as a template, and notifies clients.

methods.name: PatchBlock
methods.description: Patches a block and triggers notifications.

methods.name: PatchBlockAndNotify
methods.description: Patches a block, updates clients via websocket and webhook, and sends notifications.

methods.name: PatchBlocks
methods.description: Batch patches multiple blocks and notifies clients.

methods.name: PatchBlocksAndNotify
methods.description: Batch patches blocks, updates clients, and sends notifications.

methods.name: InsertBlock
methods.description: Inserts a new block and notifies clients.

methods.name: InsertBlockAndNotify
methods.description: Inserts a block, updates clients, and sends notifications.

methods.name: InsertBlocks
methods.description: Inserts multiple blocks and notifies clients.

methods.name: InsertBlocksAndNotify
methods.description: Inserts multiple blocks, updates clients, and sends notifications.

methods.name: GetBlockByID
methods.description: Retrieves a block by its ID.

methods.name: DeleteBlock
methods.description: Deletes a block and notifies clients.

methods.name: DeleteBlockAndNotify
methods.description: Deletes a block, updates clients, and sends notifications.

methods.name: GetLastBlockHistoryEntry
methods.description: Fetches the most recent history entry for a block.

methods.name: UndeleteBlock
methods.description: Restores a previously deleted block and notifies clients.

methods.name: GetBlockCountsByType
methods.description: Returns a count of blocks grouped by type.

methods.name: GetBlocksForBoard
methods.description: Retrieves all blocks for a specific board.

methods.name: notifyBlockChanged
methods.description: Sends notifications about block changes to relevant services.

methods.name: getBoardAndCard
methods.description: Traverses block hierarchy to find associated board and card.
